description: This file defines a Java record called RateQuote, representing a normalized shipping quote from a provider. It includes validations in its constructor to ensure non-null, non-blank string fields and a non-negative amount.

classes.name: RateQuote
classes.description: A record encapsulating the shipping provider's rate quote details, including provider name, service level, service name, and amount, with validation logic in the constructor.

methods.name: RateQuote (Constructor)
methods.description: Validates constructor arguments to ensure provider, serviceLevel, serviceName, and amount are non-null and non-blank, and amount is non-negative.
